Nalanda Medical
College & Hospital
(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹1,460.50
lakh was the net effect of
increase of ₹ 1,473.00
lakh and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹12.50 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
medical reimbursement,
office expenses, rent paid
and tax, material and
supply, medical store and
scholarships. Decrease
was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
